liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (3 reviews): Harmonica performance in this song captured the listener's attention; Early version features maracas and is considered a treasure [2][4][6]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Slower performance than the start of the year, with a brief solo [6]

## The recordings

- **gd69-12-21.sbd.vernon.12927.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 7 songs; 49 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is nice, but the performance lacks magic; Stereo soundboard has a decent mix for 1969; Show sounds amazing despite missing songs [2][4][5][10]

## Around the show

- The recording is missing the first six songs of the set [3]
- Seventy-five minutes of audio will appear on the bonus CD [7]
- Final show of the final run at the original Fillmore [11]
- This was the final California show of the 1960s [11]
- Following The Other One with Cumberland Blues is a mood wrecker [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-12-21.sbd.vernon.12927.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raoul Duke and Matt Vernon; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Drums has a splice and one minor warble or glitch; Possible splice at the very start of The Other One [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Fillmore, Dec. '69 Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1969/artwork/fillmore-dec-69-poster) [14]
